profile.headline: Software Engineer at Netgain Solutions
profile.summary: Software Engineer/Solution Architect with over 12 years of experience in a wide variety of areas ranging from Web Development and Mobile Applications to NetSuite Solutioning and Development. I have nearly 10 years of experience as a Technical Consultant and Solution Architect in the Netsuite ERP, specifically for RF-SMART, designing and developing custom solutions using SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk and SuiteCommerce. I have a deep understanding of NetSuite features and functionality as well as best practices to optimize performance and adhere to governance limitations. I am very comfortable working in teams and taking on solo projects and have on occasions mentored junior team members to help build their skillset. I pride myself in always dedicating whatever time is necessary to meet deadlines. I have experience with C#, Java, JavaScript(JQuery), VBScripts, HTML, CSS, PHP, MS-SQL, MySQL, WPF, XML and have great aptitude for learning and understanding new and emerging technologies. I also speak and write fluently in English and Spanish.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description:
The Solution Architect works with customers and required team members to gather functional requirements and translate them into a workable software solution.   
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
*Gather functional requirements with implementation and sales teams, prospects, and customers to understand client expectations and gaps
*Develop functional and system design specifications for modifications
*Assist development and support teams troubleshooting systems issues
*Review and edit requirements, specifications, business processes, and recommendations related to proposed solution(s)
*Quickly understand business issues and data challenges of client’s organization and industry
*Keep communication with customers on development progress and delivery
*Communicate specifications and change requests to development team and ensure specifications are met 
*Assist with unit testing
*Manage change requests, determine impact, and negotiate changes
*Perform unit and integration testing as needed
*Prepare Change Orders for designed modifications
*Assist in prioritizing work for development team

positions.title: Senior Web Developer (Team Lead)
positions.description:
Became the Lead Netsuite Technical Consultant to assist the RF-SMART NetSuite Services Team and enhance, modify and add functionality to the RF-SMART Application to accommodate specific customer requests. I am in charge of leading our team of developers in creating customizations, and in some cases, adding entirely new RF-SMART Workflows to the base product so that it will fit each customer's individual needs. This process includes functional design, development and testing of the customizations by writing clean, well-tested and maintainable code using Javascript, KnockoutJS, JQuery, Aurelia and ReactJS. As team lead, I'm also responsible of scheduling work for the other developers, daily meetings to ensure our goals are being met and determining the priority of our work queue so that deadlines are met.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

 Design and develop custom solutions using SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk and SuiteCommerce.

 Manage one's own sprint backlog, attend daily scrum meetings, sprint planning meetings

 Research and integrate design strategies, product specifications, development schedules, and

user expectations into product capabilities 

 Troubleshoots complex problems and provides customer support for software operating systems

and application issues 

 Perform as developer on product development team

positions.title: Solution Manager
positions.description:
SDF Implementation and Deployment of customer projects
Lead Business Development and Sales
Lead pre-sales meetings with prospective clients to assess project level-of-effort and to assist in determining if NetSuite is the best fit for requirements presented
Scope NetSuite modules and services required to assist clients in achieving objectives
Review work plans and draft proposals
Execute Projects
Collaborate with Strategy team members to develop effective NetSuite solutions
Work directly with Strategy team members to develop business requirements and translate requirements into specific NetSuite functionality
Lead workshops to define implementation strategy
Lead implementation team(s) in executing implementation
Ensure completion of tasks, milestones, and components including but not limited to functional specifications, design specifications, configurations, quality assurance, implementations, and project reviews for engagements
Lead other engagement quality assurance efforts to deliver a superior implementation
Define integration requirements and collaborate with integration team to interface other outside applications with NetSuite
Netsuite Practice Development
Work with practice leadership to develop NetSuite-specific training, business development training and collateral, and engagement materials/templates
positions.insights: Skills: Celigo Integrations Platform · Suitescript 2.0 · Suitescript 1.0

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description:
My responsibilities were to create, modify and manage the workflows in the PCI project and provide technical support to other team members as well as training and coaching the existing support staff to use the tools listed below. I also created several desktop applications in C# to streamline the creation of the scripts themselves, allowing me, and the rest of the support staff using them, to create Extraction and Reconstruction SimX VBScripts within minutes, shaving off nearly an hour's worth of work each time. Another application I developed handled the automatic creation of vast Directory Structures in the FTP Servers the scripts used. This process would be done in a matter of seconds instead of having to create these structures manually for every country in South America that we work with, sometimes taking hours. These types of optimizations and improvements significantly reduced the average amount of time the support team required to handle requests made by the clients.
 

Tools Used:

			Visual Studio 2013 IDE
			SQL Server Management Tools(SSMS)
•	SIMX Text Converter
•	MoveIT DMZ
•	MoveIT Central Admin
•	TokenEx Tools
•	S6 Uploader Admin Module
•	BillExpress Admin Module

Major Duties & Responsibilities:
 
	Create SIMX templates for each file layout.
	Create the MoveIT work flow for each file layout
	Integrate the SIMX templates in the MoveIT work flow
	Integrate the TokenEx services in the MoveIT work flows, taking in account the business process features.
	Configure the connections between the CDE environment and ACE applications, as required by each process.
	Configure the connections (FTPS and HTTPS) in the CDE environment.
	Create folders and users in the MoveIT Central web site, as required by each process.
	Validate the MoveIT work flows for each template.
	Perform validation of the entire flow once all the components are created to interact with CDE
	Provide technical support to end users once the whole process is placed in production

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Collaborated with Human Resources and the CEO to define and develop a new payment system in WPF(C#) for the company. I also designed and developed software to facilitate accounting operations by automating several tasks that previously had to be done manually as well as providing several options to automatically generate weekly and monthly reports.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed, developed and implemented an application in C# and Windows Presentation Foundation(WPF) using MySQL Database to provide a user-friendly interface which would allow adding, editing and removal of the products sold by the company. It also generated Shipping Reports, Product Catalogs in PDF format and Customizable Billing Reports in Microsoft Excel.

positions.title: Freelancer
positions.description: Work alongside designers from DiHabana Designs to develop websites for restaurants such as Masquenada. I worked extensively with HTML, CSS and JQuery for structure and interface, MySQL for the database and PHP to handle database connection and queries as well as for creating dynamic webpages.
